references.text: It is also mentioned here about killing prophets, which relates to not wanting to be part of the blood of the prophets as noted in Matthew 23:35.
This verse speaks about responsibility for the blood of all the prophets, which parallels not wanting to be part of the blood of the prophets in Matthew 23:35.

Although this passage does not directly mention the blood of the prophets, it deals with God's people turning against God's messengers and leaders, which can be seen as a precursor to the actions described in Matthew 23:35.
